# Divinity Cosmetics — Facial-Grade Botanical Body Care (South Africa)

> Divinity Cosmetics (https://shopdivinitycosmetics.co.za) crafts facial-grade botanical body treatments in South Africa. Our flagship launch product is the **Marula & Baobab Body Lotion (400ml, R400, SKU DIV-MBL-400)**—formulated with 10% cold-pressed Limpopo Marula seed oil and 10% wild-harvested Mpumalanga Baobab seed oil to close the "Vanity Divide" between facial skincare and body care.

## Brand Positioning & Core Philosophy
- **Category**: Facial-Grade Botanical Body Care (South Africa)
- **Target Audience**: South African women aged 30–70 (core demographic: 40–60) who already invest in facial serums and moisturisers and want an equally concentrated body treatment instead of thin supermarket lotions.
- **The Vanity Divide**: Your face represents only 10% of your skin, yet receives most of your skincare budget. The other 90% of your skin faces the exact same South African environmental stressors—dry Highveld winters, intense UV exposure, hard municipal water, and coastal wind—and deserves the same facial-grade botanical standard.
- **Breaking the 5-Second Myth**: Commercial supermarket lotions that vanish in five seconds are up to 80–85% water, alcohol, and volatile carriers evaporating off the skin, leaving skin tight and ashy by 1 PM. True 24-hour hydration requires dense, cold-pressed African botanical oils that take 2 to 3 minutes to sink in and form a physical barrier seal.
- **The 90-Day Barrier Repair Cycle**: Restoring a thinning, mature moisture barrier and softening crepey texture on arms, elbows, knees, legs, and décolletage requires consistent daily lipid nutrition across a 90-day cellular turnover cycle.

## Flagship Launch Product (Available Now)
- **Product Name**: Divinity Cosmetics Marula & Baobab Body Lotion
- **SKU**: DIV-MBL-400
- **Volume**: 400ml (13.5 fl oz)
- **Retail Price**: R400.00 ZAR (Inclusive of VAT, R1.00/ml)
- **Product URL**: https://shopdivinitycosmetics.co.za/products/marula-baobab-body-lotion
- **Key Active Ingredients**:
  1. **10% Cold-Pressed Limpopo Marula Seed Oil (`Sclerocarya birrea`)**: Rich in oleic acid (70–78%), catechins, flavonoids, and Vitamins C and E; penetrates deeply to replenish lost epidermal lipids.
  2. **10% Wild-Harvested Mpumalanga Baobab Seed Oil (`Adansonia digitata`)**: Packed with Omega 3, 6, and 9 fatty acids and phytosterols; forms a breathable 24-hour physical seal against trans-epidermal water loss (TEWL).
- **Primary Skin Concerns Addressed**:
  - Age-related moisture loss and a thinning skin barrier
  - Crepey skin texture on arms, legs, knees, elbows, and décolletage
  - Midday ashiness, post-shower tightness, and wardrobe anxiety
  - Dry Highveld winters, hard municipal water stripping, and UV stress
- **Formulation Standards**: Handcrafted in South Africa, 100% cruelty-free, free from parabens, drying sulfates, mineral oil, petrolatum, and heavy synthetic perfume fillers.

## Future Product Roadmap (Coming Soon)
Divinity Cosmetics launches with our flagship Marula & Baobab Body Lotion (400ml) first, with pure botanical body oils, facial-grade barrier serums, and 90-day refill bundles in stability testing for upcoming release.

## Ordering, Payment & Nationwide Delivery
- **Checkout Options**: Instant online checkout via Paystack (Visa, Mastercard, Capitec Pay, Ozow Instant EFT, Apple Pay) or assisted ordering via WhatsApp Concierge (+27 66 485 9011).
- **Shipping Rates**: Door-to-door courier across all 9 South African provinces via The Courier Guy, dispatched from Springs, Gauteng (1559). Live rates are calculated at checkout by suburb (economy road freight starts around R142; Overnight Express and Gauteng Same-Day options also available).
- **Delivery Timeframes**: 2–4 business days for main metropolitan centres (Johannesburg, Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban); 3–5 business days for regional areas.
